messages.english: Aren't you a tasty little thing?
messages.translation: 你可真是个美味的小家伙，不是吗？

messages.english: We're going to have a lot of fun together.
messages.translation: 我们在一起会玩得很开心。

messages.english: Let's make your enemies cower, shall we?
messages.translation: 让你的敌人们发抖吧，怎么样？

messages.english: You scratch my back, I'll scratch yours... and I'm one HELL of a backscratcher.
messages.translation: 你帮我，我帮你……而我可是一位来自地狱的好帮手。

messages.english: Another aspirant of the Dark Ways? We shall bring them all to heel together!
messages.translation: 又一个黑暗之道的追寻者？我们将一同让众生臣服！

messages.english: At last, a scion truly worthy of my power.
messages.translation: 终于，一个真正配得上我力量的传人。

messages.english: Finally, someone more useful than... these people.
messages.translation: 终于来了个比……这群家伙更有用的人。

messages.english: I knew you could not resist the dark call for long.
messages.translation: 我就知道，你抵挡不了黑暗的呼唤太久。

messages.english: I shall forgive your past transgressions, as long as you remember your place this time.
messages.translation: 只要你这次记住自己的地位，我就原谅你过去的冒犯。

messages.english: I shall graciously assume that you are merely clumsy, not stupid.
messages.translation: 我会宽宏大量地认为，你只是笨手笨脚，而非愚蠢。

messages.english: Don't test my patience; I have made greater than you beg for death over less!
messages.translation: 别考验我的耐心；比你更强大的人，曾因更小的过错而向我乞求一死！

messages.english: You'll be back again, mark my words....
messages.translation: 你还会回来的，记住我的话……

messages.english: Dare you to relinquish me? You shall regret this insult!
messages.translation: 你竟敢舍弃我？你会为这番羞辱后悔的！

messages.english: How arrogant, to think that any shield could be mightier than the power of Zonguldrok!
messages.translation: 竟以为区区盾牌能胜过宗古多克的力量，何等狂妄！

messages.english: wall of the weird stuff which makes up Pandemonium
messages.translation: 构成魔窟的怪异物质之墙

messages.english: Sonic Wave: It radiates damaging sonic waves as it strikes, especially in combat involving dangerous or numerous foes.
messages.translation: 音波: 命中时放出能造成伤害的音波，面对危险或数量众多的敌人时尤为强烈。

messages.english:
It causes slowness and exhaustion when equipped.
It extends the wielder's berserk rage when killing foes.
messages.translation:
装备时会造成迟缓和疲惫。
杀死敌人时，会延长持有者的狂暴时间。

messages.english: Chaos Arc: It occasionally unleashes arcs of chaos on nearby creatures upon striking a foe.
messages.translation: 混沌电弧: 命中敌人时，偶尔会向附近生物释放混沌电弧。

messages.english: Prune:     It halves damage taken while paralysed, petrified or unconscious.
messages.translation: 普鲁恩: 在麻痹、石化或昏迷时，使受到的伤害减半。

messages.english: Envenom: If the wielder is skilled in Evocations, they can envenom those struck by it, dealing poison damage which bypasses armour.
messages.translation: 灌毒: 若持有者擅长唤发，可使命中的目标受到无视护甲的毒素伤害。

messages.english:
Radiate: It can be activated via the 'a'bility menu to radiate toxic energy, with effectiveness depending on Evocations skill.
Alch: It enhances your alchemy magic.
rPois∞: It grants immunity to poison.
messages.translation:
毒能辐射: 可通过能力菜单（a）发动毒能辐射，效果取决于唤发技能。
炼金: 增强你的炼金术。
毒免疫: 使你免疫毒素。

messages.english: Mindtap:  Whenever a successful spell causes magic to be channelled from it, it may also drain additional magic from other enemies in sight, with a chance increasing with spell level.
messages.translation: 汲念: 成功施法并从中引导魔力时，也可能从视野内的其他敌人身上吸取额外魔力；几率随法术等级提高。

messages.english: Megavamp:  It occasionally heals its wielder for the full amount of damage dealt when it wounds a living foe.
messages.translation: 强效吸血: 伤害活物时，偶尔会按造成伤害的全部数值治疗持有者。

messages.english: Curses:    It inflicts powerful necromantic curses on any living foe it strikes.
messages.translation: 诅咒: 对命中的活物施加强大的死灵诅咒。

messages.english: Torment:   It occasionally torments all nearby living foes when it strikes in combat.
messages.translation: 折磨: 近战命中时，偶尔会折磨附近所有活着的敌人。

messages.english: Hellfire:  It temporarily reduces the fire resistance of those it strikes.
messages.translation: 地狱火: 暂时降低命中目标的火焰抗性。

messages.english: +Damnation: It grants the ability to hurl damnation at the cost of health and magic, with strength depending on Evocations skill.
messages.translation: +天谴: 允许消耗生命与魔力投掷地狱火，强度取决于唤发技能。

messages.english: Hellfire Court: It may summon demons of flame and damnation when striking foes.
messages.translation: 地狱火宫廷: 命中敌人时，可能召唤掌控火焰与天谴的恶魔。

messages.english: Umbra:     It surrounds you with an aura of shadow, increasing your stealth and reducing the accuracy of all others within it.
messages.translation: 暗影光环: 使你笼罩在暗影气场中，增强你的潜行，并降低范围内其他所有生物的命中率。

messages.english: Evervamp:  It heals its wielder for a portion of the damage dealt every time it strikes a living foe.
messages.translation: 持续吸血: 每次命中活物时，都按造成伤害的一部分治疗持有者。

messages.english: Execute:   It may instantly slay those it strikes, especially weaker foes.
messages.translation: 处决: 可能瞬间杀死命中的目标，对较弱敌人尤其有效。

messages.english: Spectral:  When it strikes, its spirit leaps out and fights alongside the wielder.
messages.translation: 幽灵: 命中时，武器之灵会跃出，与持有者并肩作战。

messages.english: Zealotry:  Whenever the wielder enters a berserk rage, their allies are berserked alongside them.
messages.translation: 狂热: 持有者进入狂暴时，其盟友也会一同狂暴。

messages.english: Damnation: Any ammunition fired from it explodes in a burst of damnation on striking a foe, dealing damage which bypasses armour.
messages.translation: 天谴: 射出的弹药命中敌人时，会爆发天谴，造成无视护甲的伤害。

messages.english: Decimate: It inflicts additional damage proportional to its victim's maximum health.
messages.translation: 摧残: 按受害者生命上限的一定比例造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Halo:      It grants its wielder a halo, revealing invisible creatures and increasing accuracy against all within it other than the wielder.
messages.translation: 光环: 为持有者赋予光环，揭示隐形生物，并提高对范围内其他所有生物的命中率。

messages.english: Ele:       It enhances your fire, ice, earth and air magic. If skilled in Evocations, you can discharge powerful blasts of elemental energy when striking with it.
messages.translation: 元素: 增强你的火系、冰系、土系与气系魔法。若擅长唤发，还能在近战命中时释放强大的元素能量。

messages.english: Acc+∞:     It never misses its target.
messages.translation: 命中+∞: 永远不会射失目标。

messages.english: Slay Drac: It inflicts extra damage against dragons and draconians.
messages.translation: 屠龙: 对龙与龙人造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Stab:      It is more effective when stabbing unaware enemies, sometimes treating them as though they were completely helpless.
messages.translation: 背刺: 对毫无察觉的敌人发动背刺时更有效，有时会将其视为完全无力反抗。

messages.english: Mutate:    It occasionally inflicts wild transmutation effects on those it strikes, inflicting malmutation or extra damage, or polymorphing them into a new form.
messages.translation: 致变: 命中时，偶尔会对目标施加狂野的变形效果，造成恶性变异、额外伤害，或将其变为另一种形态。

messages.english: Deathbane: It inflicts significantly more damage against the undead.
messages.translation: 亡灵克星: 对亡灵造成显著增加的伤害。

messages.english: Curare:    It occasionally inflicts asphyxiating poison on those it strikes, dealing poison damage and causing slowness.
messages.translation: 箭毒: 偶尔使命中目标受到窒息性毒素侵袭，造成毒素伤害和迟缓。

messages.english: Disarm:    It may disarm weapon-wielding foes when striking them, dealing extra damage in the process.
messages.translation: 缴械: 命中持有武器的敌人时，可能将其缴械，并在此过程中造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Penet:     Any ammunition fired by it passes through the targets it hits, potentially hitting all targets in its path until it reaches maximum range.
messages.translation: 穿透: 射出的弹药会穿过命中的目标，可能沿途命中所有目标，直到达到最远射程。

messages.english: Quiet:      All noise in your surroundings is dampened.
messages.translation: 静谧: 减弱你周围的所有噪音。

messages.english: Bear:      Going berserk makes the wearer exceptionally tough, and they are slowed for a shorter time afterward.
messages.translation: 熊灵: 狂暴时使穿戴者格外坚韧，且随后迟缓的持续时间更短。

messages.english:
Detect:    It allows the wearer to sense nearby creatures.
Stab+:     It allows the wearer to make particularly effective stabbing attacks against helpless or unaware enemies with any melee weapon.
messages.translation:
探知: 允许穿戴者感知附近生物。
背刺+: 允许穿戴者使用任何近战武器，对无力反抗或毫无察觉的敌人发动格外有效的背刺。

messages.english: *Englaciate: It radiates cold, occasionally slowing all nearby creatures who are not resistant to cold.
messages.translation: *冰封: 散发寒气，偶尔使附近所有不具寒冷抗性的生物迟缓。

messages.english:
Flames:    It surrounds you with flame clouds.
rFlCloud:  It grants immunity to flame clouds.
messages.translation:
烈焰: 以火焰云雾环绕你。
抗火云: 使你免疫火焰云雾。

messages.english:
Brill:     It increases the power of your magical spells and halves their MP cost (rounding up).
Will-∞:    It reduces your willpower to zero.
messages.translation:
辉煌: 提高法术强度，并使魔力消耗减半（向上取整）。
意志-∞: 使你的意志降至零。

messages.english: Dragonpray: It occasionally summons a dragon when using Invocations with hostile monsters in sight. Chance is 10% + twice the piety cost of the ability used.
messages.translation: 祈龙: 视野内有敌对怪物时，使用祈祷能力偶尔会召唤一条龙。几率为 10% 加上所用能力虔诚消耗的两倍。

messages.english: Dark:      It shrouds the wearer in darkness, reducing the range at which they can see and be seen by others.
messages.translation: 黑暗: 以黑暗笼罩穿戴者，缩小其视野及被其他生物看见的距离。

messages.english: Riposte:   It allows the wearer to riposte with melee weapons, swiftly retaliating against missed or blocked melee attacks.
messages.translation: 还击: 允许穿戴者使用近战武器还击，在敌人的近战攻击落空或被抵挡后迅速反击。

messages.english: *Dazzle:   It may blind adjacent enemies who miss an attack against the wearer in melee combat.
messages.translation: *炫目: 相邻敌人的近战攻击落空时，可能使其失明。

messages.english: *Rats:     When the wearer is hurt, rats may emerge from it to assist them.
messages.translation: *鼠群: 穿戴者受伤时，可能有老鼠从中钻出提供援助。

messages.english: Loud:      It is deafeningly noisy when blocking attacks.
messages.translation: 喧闹: 抵挡攻击时，会发出震耳欲聋的噪声。

messages.english: Inacc:     It reduces the accuracy of your attacks and spells.
messages.translation: 失准: 降低你攻击和法术的命中率。

messages.english: Fury:      It extends the wearer's berserk rage when killing foes.
messages.translation: 狂怒: 杀死敌人时，会延长穿戴者的狂暴时间。

messages.english:
*Thunder:  It occasionally creates storm clouds above nearby enemies.
rCloud:    It grants its wearer immunity to clouds.
messages.translation:
*雷云: 偶尔在附近敌人上方制造风暴云。
抗云雾: 使穿戴者免疫云雾。

messages.english: Demonic:   It occasionally summons demons to assist the wielder when it strikes in combat.
messages.translation: 恶魔: 近战命中时，偶尔召唤恶魔协助持有者。

messages.english: Mesm:      Its wielder is mesmerised by any visible foes, and it cannot be unequipped while any foes are visible.
messages.translation: 魅惑: 任何可见的敌人都会使持有者着迷；只要视野内仍有敌人，就无法卸下它。

messages.english: Swift:     It allows the wearer to cover ground more swiftly.
messages.translation: 迅捷: 使穿戴者能更快地移动。

messages.english: Manifold Assault: It sometimes launches melee attacks against multiple visible enemies.
messages.translation: 多重突袭: 有时对多个可见敌人发动近战攻击。

messages.english: Shatter:   It releases a powerful concussive burst when it strikes, dealing extra damage to the target and all other creatures adjacent to them.
messages.translation: 震碎: 命中时释放强大的震荡冲击，对目标及其相邻的所有其他生物造成额外伤害。

messages.english: Avatar's Aegis: It grants the wearer a chance to resist fire, cold, poison, electricity, acid, and negative energy.
messages.translation: 化身神盾: 使穿戴者有机会抵御火焰、寒冷、毒素、电击、酸蚀及负能量。

messages.english: Ring+:   It enables you to equip an extra ring.
messages.translation: 戒指+: 允许额外装备一枚戒指。

messages.english: Discharge: It occasionally unleashes powerful arcs of lightning upon striking a foe. These may arc to other adjacent creatures (including the wielder, but dealing reduced damage to them) before grounding out.
messages.translation: 放电: 命中敌人时，偶尔释放强大的闪电电弧；电弧可能传导至其他相邻生物（包括持有者，但对其造成的伤害较低），之后才导入地面。

messages.english: Disrupt:   It unleashes wild and unpredictable magical effects upon striking a wizard or a creature with magical abilities.
messages.translation: 扰魔: 命中法师或具有魔法能力的生物时，释放狂野而难以预测的魔法效果。

messages.english: Silver:    It inflicts extra damage upon those it strikes, and deals substantially increased damage to chaotic, mutated and magically transformed beings.
messages.translation: 白银: 对命中目标造成额外伤害，对混沌、变异或魔法变形的生物造成的伤害大幅增加。

messages.english: Immolate:  It fills those it strikes with an explosive inner flame.
messages.translation: 心火: 使命中目标的体内燃起爆炸性的心火。

messages.english: rFlCloud:  It grants immunity to clouds of flame.
messages.translation: 抗火云: 使你免疫火焰云雾。

messages.english: Spellvamp: It heals its wielder for a portion of the damage dealt when they wound a living foe with it or with a spell, but its wielder's spells cost health as well as magical power.
messages.translation: 法术吸血: 用它或法术伤害活物时，会按造成伤害的一部分治疗持有者；但持有者施法时除了魔力，还要消耗生命。

messages.english: NoPotionHeal: Its wearer cannot be healed by potions.
messages.translation: 药水不疗伤: 穿戴者无法通过药水获得治疗。

messages.english: PotionHeal*2: Potions heal its wearer twice as much.
messages.translation: 药水治疗×2: 药水对穿戴者的治疗量加倍。

messages.english: Freezing Cloud: It occasionally leaves clouds of freezing vapour upon striking a foe, and grants immunity to clouds of freezing vapour.
messages.translation: 冰冻云雾: 命中敌人时，偶尔留下冰冻云雾，并使持有者免疫冰冻云雾。

messages.english: Omnireflect: It can block and reflect piercing ranged attacks and magical attacks against the wielder's willpower.
messages.translation: 全能反射: 可以抵挡并反射穿透性远程攻击，以及针对持有者意志的魔法攻击。

messages.english:
Freeze:    It freezes victims, dealing an additional one-quarter of any damage that pierces defenders' armour. It may also slow down cold-blooded creatures.
Rev:       It becomes more effective when it hits something. This effect fades over time.
messages.translation:
冻结: 冻伤目标，额外造成穿透护甲伤害的四分之一，还可能使冷血生物迟缓。
加速: 命中目标时会变得更有效；此效果随时间消退。

messages.english: Reach+:    It can reach especially far, and its reaching attacks ignore other creatures in the way.
messages.translation: 延伸+: 攻击距离格外远，且延伸攻击会忽略挡路的其他生物。

messages.english:
Battle: It summons a battlesphere in combat, with strength depending on Conjurations skill.
Destructive: It enhances your destructive magic, and weakens non-destructive magic.
messages.translation:
战斗: 在战斗中召唤作战球，强度取决于塑能系魔法技能。
毁灭: 增强你的毁灭性魔法，削弱非毁灭性魔法。

messages.english:
Corpsefed: It gathers nearby corpses to temporarily increase the armour it provides.
rMiasma:   It protects you from foul pestilence.
messages.translation:
食尸: 收集附近的尸体，暂时提高其提供的护甲值。
抗瘴气: 保护你免受污秽瘟疫侵害。

messages.english: Rampage+∞: When moving toward enemies, its wearer moves as far as possible, alerting their target en route.
messages.translation: 冲锋+∞: 向敌人移动时，穿戴者会尽可能接近目标，并在途中惊动目标。

messages.english:
Infuse+∞:  It empowers its wearer's blows with all of their magic.
VampMP:    Blows struck in melee replenish the wearer's magic.
messages.translation:
灌注+∞: 用持有者的全部魔力强化其攻击。
汲取魔力: 近战命中时补充持有者的魔力。

messages.english: *Dream:    It absorbs a single lethal wound into itself, holding its wearer just short of death and releasing dream-creatures to guard them.
messages.translation: *梦境: 吸收一次致命创伤，使穿戴者停留在死亡边缘，并释放梦境生物守护穿戴者。

messages.english: ID++:      It heals its wearer when they drink unknown potions, and restores their MP when they read unknown scrolls.
messages.translation: 鉴定++: 穿戴者饮用未知药水时恢复生命，阅读未知卷轴时恢复魔力。

messages.english: Coup de Grace: It may instantly kill foes which have little health.
messages.translation: 致命一击: 可能瞬间杀死生命值较低的敌人。

messages.english: Meekguard: It provides extra protection to wielders with little health.
messages.translation: 护弱: 为生命值较低的持有者提供额外保护。

messages.english: Anguish:   It makes its victims' attacks reflect back on them.
messages.translation: 痛楚: 使受害者的攻击反射回自身。

messages.english: Steadfast: It prevents involuntary movement, except for blinking, teleportation, or banishment.
messages.translation: 稳固: 阻止非自愿移动，但闪现、传送和放逐除外。

messages.english: Reach-Cleave: It can be evoked to extend its reach, and strikes at all foes within reach, dealing less damage to those not targeted.
messages.translation: 延伸横扫: 可发动以延长攻击距离，并攻击范围内的所有敌人；对非主目标造成的伤害较低。

messages.english: Poleaxe:   It uses either Axes or Polearms skill, whichever is higher.
messages.translation: 长柄斧: 使用斧或长柄武器技能中较高的一项。

messages.english:
Invo=14:   It sets your Invocations skill to 14.
Evo=0:    It sets your Evocations skill to 0.
messages.translation:
祈祷=14: 将你的祈祷技能设为 14。
唤发=0: 将你的唤发技能设为 0。

messages.english:
Slick:     Its wearer cannot be constricted, netted, webbed, or stopped by binding sigils.
Slippery:  Its wearer slips away from damaging melee attacks, pulling the attacker onward.
messages.translation:
滑溜: 穿戴者不会受到绞缠、投掷网、蛛网或束缚印记的限制。
滑移: 穿戴者会避开造成伤害的近战攻击，并牵引攻击者向前。

messages.english: Knockback: It sometimes drives back enemies it hits.
messages.translation: 击退: 有时击退命中的敌人。

messages.english: Valiant:   It becomes more powerful as more dangerous foes come into view.
messages.translation: 英勇: 视野中出现的敌人越危险，它就越强大。

messages.english: *Victory:  When the wearer kills a threatening monster, it has a chance to gain +1 AC, +1 Slay, and +1 Int, capping at +7. When the wearer uses a scroll or a potion with a hostile monster in sight, its bonuses reset to +0. Unequipping it also resets its bonuses to +0.
messages.translation: *胜利: 穿戴者杀死有威胁的怪物时，有机会获得 +1 护甲值、+1 杀伤和 +1 智力，最高各为 +7。视野中有敌对怪物时，穿戴者使用卷轴或药水会使加成重置为 +0；卸下它也会使加成重置为 +0。

messages.english: Shock:     When it blocks an attack, it may electrocute the attacker. This works even against foes who are a short distance away.
messages.translation: 电击: 抵挡攻击时，可能电击攻击者，即使对方距离稍远也有效。

messages.english: Backblast: When fired, it often launches its wielder backwards.
messages.translation: 后坐冲击: 发射时，经常将持有者向后击退。

messages.english:
Gadgeteer:   Your evocable items recharge 30% faster and wands have a 30% chance to not spend a charge.
Wandboost:   Your wands are more powerful.
messages.translation:
巧匠: 可发动道具的充能速度提高 30%，魔杖有 30% 几率不消耗充能。
魔杖强化: 你的魔杖更强大。

messages.english:
It massively reduces your stealth.
It interferes with translocations, delaying teleports.
Charlatan: It boosts your other skills by 20% of your base Evocations skill.
messages.translation:
大幅降低你的潜行。
干扰位移魔法，使传送延迟。
骗术: 按你的基础唤发技能的 20% 提高其他技能。

messages.english:
Inspire:   When you summon or create an ally, it gains Regeneration.
Amulet+:   You can equip an additional amulet.
messages.translation:
鼓舞: 召唤或创造盟友时，使其获得再生。
护符+: 允许额外装备一枚护符。

messages.english:
Reaping:   When you kill an enemy with your weapon, its spirit may be forced to fight for you.
Hat+:   You can equip an additional hat (on the skull).
messages.translation:
收割: 用武器杀死敌人时，其灵魂可能被迫为你作战。
帽子+: 可在头骨上额外装备一顶帽子。

messages.english:
Shroompunch:   The cloak sometimes lashes out at its wearer's enemies, inflicting confusion with its spores.
Gloves+:   Your cloak can equip an additional pair of gloves.
messages.translation:
真菌拳: 披风有时会猛击穿戴者的敌人，以孢子造成混乱。
手套+: 可为披风额外装备一副手套。

messages.english:
Majesty:   You are bathed in light that prevents you from turning invisible. Whenever you enter a new floor, you announce yourself to nearby enemies and refuse to leave the floor again for some time.
Ring++:   You can equip two additional rings.
messages.translation:
威仪: 光芒笼罩着你，使你无法隐身。每次进入新楼层，你都会向附近敌人宣告自己的到来，并在一段时间内拒绝离开该层。
戒指++: 允许额外装备两枚戒指。

真的要对%s发动净化之焰吗？%s

messages.translation: 这次攻击会使你受到惩戒！
